decisions.reason: The polymer concrete housing belongs to the core drainage portfolio and costs little to keep, although it was not visible on the website in 2020 to 2021, which adds some uncertainty.
As the flagship design drainage line, it embodies the firm's strategic direction, and its option value justifies continued commitment.
The sloped shower element fits the accessible, low-profile direction, but its weak website presence and absence in recent years make it the most vulnerable option, though keeping it remains cheap.
The DallSafe backflow basement drain was a specifically developed solution to a real building need, so its prospects remain sound and justify keeping it.
